scenarios.survey_mechanism: SURVEY DESIGN — Direct Elicitation (DE): Your report will be recorded exactly as you submit it. If you report the agent as bad and the agent committed to punish, you will incur a financial penalty.

SURVEY DESIGN — Randomized Response (RR): With probability 2/3, your report about the agent's type will be recorded directly. With probability 1/3, you will instead be asked: 'What is the color of the sky: blue or red?' A response of 'blue' will be recorded as a bad-agent report; 'red' as a not-bad report. If a bad-agent record is produced and the agent committed to punish, you will incur a financial penalty.

scenarios.commitment_text: has NOT committed to punish you
scenarios.survey_mechanism: SURVEY DESIGN — Hard Garbling (HG): If you report the agent as NOT bad, there is a 1/3 probability that the system will automatically change your report to 'bad'. This switching is random and independent of your intentions. If a report of 'bad' is recorded—whether from your choice or the system switch—and the agent committed to punish, you will incur a financial penalty.
